_comment: workspace-os lint rules for THIS repo. Copy to .claude/lint.json and edit. After every Edit/Write/MultiEdit the engine runs each entry whose `match` (regex on the file path) matches, as `<command> <file_path>`, and feeds any output back to Claude to fix. Nothing runs until you add entries to `linters` (the engine ships no built-in linters). Prefer commands that are SILENT on success (e.g. `ruff check`, `eslint`) so a clean file stays silent.
